frozen_canonical_budget_rule.rule: K_b = N_eligible if b == 1 else floor(b * N_eligible)
frozen_canonical_budget_rule.scope_limit: This rule defines K_b CARDINALITY on the eligible set. It is coupled to the CANONICAL final-router score distribution when realized as a scalar threshold tau.

frozen_canonical_scalar_thresholds.note: These scalar tau values are quantiles of the CANONICAL B_phi score distribution. They are NOT transferable to a variant router with a different score distribution.

question: For R1/R2/R3, does the ablation use the canonical A8 final-router threshold, or an equal-activation 25% recalibration, or another frozen rule?
finding: NO FROZEN RULE EXISTS for R1/R2/R3 variant activation.

analysis.reuse_canonical_threshold_blindly: REJECTED — the variant changes the score distribution; a canonical tau would produce a non-comparable activation fraction.
analysis.rank_and_force_top_25pct: REJECTED — selecting a top-K by ranking the variant's ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT scores is an outcome-adjacent calibration NOT authorized before inference.
analysis.equal_activation_recalibration: PLAUSIBLE_AND_PRINCIPLED BUT NOT PRE-REGISTERED — no authoritative source freezes it.
analysis.requires_constant_from_development_only: must be TRAIN/ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT-derived and frozen before inference (consistent with phase24 exact spec forbidden_tuning_sources)
